chip.p.name: Igama lephrojekthi
chip.p.pdk.ph: Lapho i-process design kit yakho ikhona
chip.p.studio: I-Studio isebenzisa amathuluzi owafakile ngokwakho, ifolda yamathuluzi (noma uhlu lokusesha) njengezinhlelo ezihlukene. Ukusebenza kokuqala kukucela ukuvumela i-Node ukuthi isebenzise isikripthi sokusebenza se-add-on.
chip.p.web: Lo ungumhleli wesiphequluli: ufunda futhi ubonise imiphumela, kodwa awukwazi ukuqala izinhlelo. Sebenzisa Ukugeleza › Londoloza iphakheji yokusebenza uyisebenzise kukhompyutha yakho, noma vula iphrojekthi ku-CadCraft Studio.
chip.p.honest: Akukho okufakiwe: akukho simulator, ithuluzi lokuhlanganisa noma lesakhiwo, nePDK ofika nayo ku-CadCraft. Ngokufundela nemigudu yesilicon evulekile, hhayi uhlelo lokuqeda umklamo olusayiniwe.
chip.p.memory: Lesi siphequluli asigcini amafayela ngemva kokuvala ikhasi: londoloza iphrojekthi.
chip.p.newask: Qala iphrojekthi entsha? Amafayela agcinwe kulesi siphequluli azosuswa (londoloza iphrojekthi kuqala ukuze uwagcine).
chip.files.none: Awukafiki amafayela. Engeza amafayela akho e-Verilog, noma ifolda.
chip.files.badname: {name} akuyona igama lefayela iphrojekthi engaligcina (kuphela izinhlamvu, izinombolo, _ . + - nomugqa ohlukanisayo /).
chip.flow.web: Inguqulo yesiphequluli: Qalisa idinga i-CadCraft Studio. Londoloza iphakheji yokusebenza ukuze uyisebenzise ngesandla (node engine/cc-chip-run.mjs chip-job.json), bese uVula umphumela.
chip.flow.last.ok: Ukusebenza kokugcina {at} nge-{tool}: kudlule, amafayela okufaka {n}.
chip.flow.last.bad: Ukusebenza kokugcina {at} nge-{tool}: kukhona izinkinga, amafayela okufaka {n}.
chip.opts.sim: testbench (imodyuli), defines {{NAME: value}}, plusargs ["+x=1"]. I-Icarus yengeza imodyuli encane elahla zonke izimpawu kuya ku-out/wave.vcd; i-Verilator ibonisa amagagasi kuphela uma ibhentshi lakho libiza $dumpfile.
chip.opts.synth: liberty (ifayela le-.lib laleprojekthi), period (ns), flatten (true/false), exclude [amafayela], script (isikripthi sakho se-.ys).
chip.opts.pnr: lefs [i-LEF yezobuchwepheshe kuqala, bese amaseli], libs [.lib], netlist (isb. out/synth/netlist.v), sdc, site, utilization, hLayers, vLayers, density, route (global, detailed noma none), rcx (imithetho yokukhipha, ye-SPEF), script (isikripthi sakho se-.tcl).
chip.opts.drc: gds (isakhiwo), deck (ideki yemithetho ye-DRC ye-PDK yakho), top (iseli), vars {{input, report, topcell}}: amagama ideki alifunda.
chip.opts.lvs: layout (inethlisi ekhishiwe), layoutCell, schematic (inethlisi), schematicCell, setup (ifayela lokusetha le-Netgen le-PDK yakho).
chip.opts.gls: netlist, cells [amamodeli amaseli e-PDK yakho], sdf (kusuka ekubekeni nasekuxhumeni), dut (isibonakaliso, isb. counter_tb.dut).
chip.opts.stil: Njengokulinganisa kwelinga lamageyithi (noma umklamo we-RTL uma ungekho inethlisi), kanye no-period nestrobe (ngamayunithi wesikhathi sokuphonsa), scope, inputs [], outputs [], clock [amagama].
chip.sum.delay: Indlela ende kakhulu ngemva kokumaphisa: {ps} ps.
chip.sum.pnr: Indawo yomklamo {area} µm², ukusetshenziswa {util} %, i-slack embi kakhulu {wns}.
chip.sum.nodef: Umphumela ufikile, kodwa umfundi we-DEF akukafakwa kule-add-on.
chip.stil.nowriter: Umbhali we-STIL akekho kulesi sengezo okwamanje; amavekthela {n} alondolozwe njenge-out/stil/patterns.json.
chip.stil.unknown: Amanani okufaka ayengu-x noma z ngesikhathi sokuqhuba abhalwa njenge-0: {n}.
chip.wave.none: Azikho amafayela .vcd okwamanje: qhuba ukulingisa noma yengeza elilodwa.
chip.wave.cut: Ingxenye yokuqala kuphela yafundwa (ifayela elikhulu kakhulu).
chip.wave.bad: Lona akusona isifayela se-VCD umbukisi walo angasifunda.
chip.wave.fst: Lona ulifayela le-FST. I-FST ayikafundwa okwamanje: cela umlingisi wakho i-VCD (Icarus: $dumpfile("x.vcd"); Verilator: --trace, hhayi --trace-fst).
chip.layout.none: Azikho amafayela .def okwamanje: qhuba ukubeka nokuxhuma noma yengeza elilodwa.
chip.layout.noreader: Umfundi we-DEF akekho kulesi sengezo okwamanje.
chip.p.sampleask: Vula umklamo wesampula? Amafayela agcinwe kulesi siphequluli kuleli phrojekthi ayothathelwa indawo (londoloza iphrojekthi kuqala ukuze ugcine wona).
chip.honest.title: Lokhu yini, nokuthi akuyona yini
chip.honest.text: Okokufunda nemisebenzi evulekile yesilikhoni, hhayi uhlelo lokuphothula ukukhiqizwa oluqinisekisiwe. Asinikezi i-PDK futhi asenzi izimangalo ngabakhiqizi besilikhoni. Amathuluzi ngawakho: uyawafaka, nesengezo siwaqhuba njengezinhlelo ezihlukile.
chip.cmd.dialog: Ipaneli yomklamo we-Chip ivulekile ewindini layo (leli khasi alinaphaneli yohlangothi yezengezo).
